subject: Pilot recap — quantified metrics and brief reference ask
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@arcadiaai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot recap & quick reference ask

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for running the pilot with us last month. I pulled together a short, numbers-first recap so your team can see the production impact we measured and to ask for a small reference (quote or 10–15 min call) if you’re open to it. Key highlights from the 3-week pilot (attached):

- 3.8x reduction in per-request inference cost after moving to Redwood’s batching + KV cache configuration vs baseline.
- 45% median tail latency improvement (p95 down from ~420ms to ~230ms) for the fraud-detection route.
- Stable throughput at 2.2k requests/min with the dedicated config we tested.
- No data exfil incidents; logs sent to your S3 collector for the whole run.

Attachments: redwood_pilot_summary_ARC-3492.pdf (summary + graphs), arcadia_latency_sample.csv (anonymized traces)

Would Arcadia be willing to provide either: (a) a one-paragraph quote we can feature in a short case brief, or (b) a 10–15 minute reference call with a product/eng leader? We’d be grateful either way.

If yes, quick options for a call next week (PST):
- Tue 4/27 10:00–10:15am
- Wed 4/28 11:30–11:45am
- Thu 4/28 2:00–2:15pm

If you prefer to send a line or two by email, feel free to drop it straight into your reply. For the quote, we typically ask for 1–2 sentences on the primary benefit and permission to use Arcadia’s logo (we’ll send an approval preview first).

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
[Attachment: redwood_pilot_summary_ARC-3492.pdf (PDF, 220KB)]
[Attachment: arcadia_latency_sample.csv (CSV, 85KB)]

Hi Lauren —

Thanks for the clear recap and for sending the datasets. Great to see the latency and cost delta — that matches what our infra team observed. I ran this by Tom (cc’d) and we’re happy to help. A couple quick clarifying points:

1) Attribution: we’re comfortable with a short quote attributed to Arcadia AI, but would like to review the final copy before publishing.
2) Scope: happy to be in a short reference call that focuses on architecture and operational experience; we’d prefer not to surface internal KPIs beyond what’s in your summary PDF.

Tom, any scheduling constraints on your side for a 10–15 min sync this week? If you want, I can draft a 1–2 sentence quote for Lauren to use.

Best,
Elena

elena@arcadiaai.com
